inspected_primary_documents.title: Ironies of Automation
inspected_primary_documents.read: Sections 1.1 and 2, printed pp.775–777, PDF pp.1–3; extracted lines 73–383.
inspected_primary_documents.limits: Not a fresh verification of its cited studies or remaining collaboration section.

inspected_primary_documents.title: The theory of graceful extensibility: basic rules that govern adaptive systems
inspected_primary_documents.read: Table 1; sections 2.3/2.4, PDF pp.11–16; relevant 3.2 passage pp.19–20. Extraction and full text-context around reciprocity, reserve and switching paragraphs.
inspected_primary_documents.limits: No independent checking of cited case studies or complete derivation of every statement.

inspected_primary_documents.title: Collective Action and the Evolution of Social Norms
inspected_primary_documents.read: Author's April 6, 2000 prepublication version, printed pp.13 and 16–19: crowd-out, design principles and reinforcing monitoring/conflict resolution. Publisher identity checked.
inspected_primary_documents.limits: Not the published pagination; other sections and underlying field evidence not exhaustively inspected. Governing the Commons downloads failed and are not counted.

inspected_primary_documents.title: Resilience and Stability of Ecological Systems
inspected_primary_documents.read: 1973 article introduction and Application section, merged PDF pp.3 and 23; extracted lines 11–24 and 752–770.
inspected_primary_documents.limits: Merged file also contains a later Holling paper, explicitly excluded; no ecological model proof checked.

inspected_primary_documents.title: Corrigibility
inspected_primary_documents.read: Introduction, section 2 shutdown desiderata and section 5 discussion, PDF pp.1–3 and 8–9.
inspected_primary_documents.limits: Not a reproduction of all utility calculations; absence of a reserve loop in these passages is not a claim about all corrigibility literature.

inspected_primary_documents.title: Nobody Ever Gets Credit for Fixing Problems That Never Happened: Creating and Sustaining Process Improvement
inspected_primary_documents.read: Printed pp.66–74, 80–83: stock/flow diagrams, Reinvestment, Shortcuts, reward feedback and Du Pont maintenance example; targeted full paragraphs inspected.
inspected_primary_documents.limits: Not every field case or supporting simulation replicated; 2002 successor paper discovered but not counted as inspected.

inspected_primary_documents.title: Metastable Failures in Distributed Systems
inspected_primary_documents.read: Sections 1–3, PDF pp.1–4, especially 2.1 retries, 2.3 error handling and adaptive policies/prioritization.
inspected_primary_documents.limits: Simplified operating examples; no reproduction of production incidents or complete literature coverage.

inspected_primary_documents.title: Metastable Failures in the Wild
inspected_primary_documents.read: Sections 3.3–3.5, Figure 1, definitions and theorem statements, PDF pp.6–9; primary conference metadata.
inspected_primary_documents.limits: Proof appendices and all 22 incident reconstructions not inspected. Bounded amplification of organic load differs from T07's unbounded backlog-proportional work.

inspected_primary_documents.title: The Transaction Concept: Virtues and Limitations
inspected_primary_documents.read: Introduction; general model; Nested Transactions and Long-Lived Transactions, printed pp.144–145 and 152–153, extracted lines 40–148 and 897–1065.
inspected_primary_documents.limits: Historical transaction model, not legal advice or a claim about current contract law; no reconstruction of cited deadlock formulas.

inspected_primary_documents.limits: Scanned pages have no extractable text; OCR equations were not treated as verified formal results. Remaining implementation and cost sections not inspected.
